pricing_faq_text: Credits, billing and what changes when you upgrade.
pricing_faq_1_a: A credit would pay for one AI-powered job in the cloud, such as removing a background. Bigger jobs may use more than one. The amounts shown are proposals, and the final rules will be published before paid plans launch.
pricing_faq_2_q: Do I need a paid plan to use the browser tools?
pricing_faq_2_a: No. Browser tools are free, need no account and have no monthly limit. They run on your device, so your files are never uploaded.
pricing_faq_3_a: That is not decided yet. We will say it clearly before paid plans launch.
pricing_faq_4_a: The API is a future product. The Pro plan would include access to it, with usage billed separately. It is not available yet.
pricing_faq_5_q: When will paid plans be available?
pricing_faq_5_a: We do not have a date. Paid plans are coming soon, and nothing paid can be purchased yet.
pricing_faq_6_q: Can I cancel at any time?
pricing_faq_6_a: There is nothing to cancel yet, because paid plans are not on sale. The final terms will be published before they launch.
pricing_cta_heading: Start free, upgrade when you need the cloud
pricing_cta_text: Browser tools are free, with no sign-up and no monthly limit. Your files stay on your device.
